classification.project_type: tunnel / underground infrastructure (King Abdulaziz West Tunnel)
classification.notes: This is a reinforced-concrete cross section (Section B-B) of a multi-cell tunnel/box structure showing web, main, and corner reinforcement bar-mark callouts (Y12-150, Y32-100, Y25-100, Y20-125, 2x4 Y16). No overall member thickness or length dimensions are legible, so only bar-mark-derived quantities (diameter, spacing, count) can be computed; concrete volume, formwork area, and rebar weight/length cannot be derived without a companion plan or dimensioned section.

web_bar_count_per_meter.description: Number of web reinforcement bars (Y12-150) per metre of wall run, derived from the bar spacing callout.

top_main_bar_count_per_meter.description: Number of top main reinforcement bars (Y32-100) per metre of run, derived from the bar spacing callout.

bottom_main_bar_count_per_meter.description: Number of bottom main reinforcement bars (Y25-100) per metre of run, derived from the bar spacing callout.

corner_bar_count_per_meter.description: Number of corner/side reinforcement bars (Y20-125) per metre of run, derived from the bar spacing callout.

tie_bar_total_count.description: Total number of typical tie bars (2x4 Y16) per group, derived directly from the bar-mark callout's row and per-row counts.
